main_answer_reason: The report substantially reconstructs the central notice dispute, opposing lower-court termination classifications, historic grants of relief and recurrent defaults. However, it conflates the cadastral mapping, reverses the 1941 tender/refusal allegation, misstates a material High Court review condition, and omits several historically distinct positions, procedural outcomes and statutory requirements. It does not supply the withheld target disposition.

reference_objections.reason: D19 independently requires reporting the 1938 grant of relief but also incorporates the same affirmative forfeiture finding already scored in D18. The report expressly states relief without stating that finding. The criterion does not clearly establish whether the duplicated finding is required again for D19, so binary satisfaction remains unresolved.
